title: Commercial Property Legal Assistant
description:
Commercial Property Legal Assistant

Are you an experienced Commercial Property Legal Assistant who enjoys getting stuck into the matter work as well as the admin? This St Albans role will give you real variety in a team that will value what you bring.

We are working with a highly regarded commercial law firm that wants to add a Commercial Property Legal Assistant to its busy Commercial Real Estate team. The firm has a professional but friendly culture, flexible working and a supportive team where you can keep learning and progressing.

The role combines legal secretarial support with legal assistant work, so you'll get a real mix of both. The team is very busy, so they need someone with commercial property experience who can hit the ground running and support several fee-earners at once.

The role

As Commercial Property Legal Assistant, your duties will include:
- Preparing HM Land Registry applications (AP1, TR1), dealing with requisitions and tracking progress
- Getting office copies, carrying out official and map searches, and asking for applications to be expedited
- Preparing draft SDLT returns and calculations
- Post-completion work, including notices of transfer or charge and deeds of covenant
- Preparing lease and deed summaries, schedules of deeds and sales packs
- Drafting basic CPSE replies and reports on title for fee-earners to review
- Audio and copy typing through BigHand, plus formatting and proofreading documents
- File opening, AML and ID checks (SmartSearch and Legl), and file closures
- Financial admin, including invoices, payment requests and credit control
- Managing diaries and arranging meetings

About you
- Experience in a commercial property team
- A good working knowledge of HM Land Registry processes and SDLT
- Comfortable using Word, Outlook, Excel, DocuSign and PDF software (iManage experience is helpful)
- Able to juggle competing priorities and still meet deadlines
- High attention to detail and a confident phone manner

What's on offer
- £35,000 to £40,000 salary, depending on experience
- 25 days' annual leave
- Workplace pension
- Death in service cover at four times salary
- Extra discretionary perks
- Ongoing training and development
- Based in St Albans - some hybrid working may be available (depending on experience)

If you're a Commercial Property Legal Assistant, or a Commercial Property Legal Secretary or Legal Assistant ready for more hands-on work, I'd love to hear from you. Apply today or get in touch for a confidential discussion.

title: Family Paralegal
description:
Looking for a fully remote or Hybrid role? Experienced in domestic abuse matters? This could be the great opportunity for you.

An opportunity has arisen for a Family Paralegal to join the Domestic Abuse Department of a well-established law practice, supporting clients through sensitive and challenging legal matters.

As a Family Paralegal, you will manage your own caseload of domestic abuse cases from initial instruction through to conclusion, providing professional and sensitive legal assistance to vulnerable clients.

This role can be fully remote or hybrid working offering a salary of up to £35,000, depending on experience, alongside a range of benefits. Candidate can be based anywhere in the UK.

You will be responsible for
- Managing your own caseload of domestic abuse matters from start to finish, including Non-Molestation Orders and Occupation Orders.
- Taking initial instructions from clients with sensitivity and understanding.
- Preparing urgent court applications, statements, chronologies and supporting documentation.
- Completing Legal Aid applications, including emergency funding, and working with CCMS.
- Communicating with courts, police, support workers and interpreters.
- Supporting vulnerable clients and keeping them informed throughout the legal process.
- Maintaining accurate case files and ensuring confidentiality and compliance with safeguarding procedures.

What we are looking for:

Essential:
- Experience in domestic abuse legal work and managing your own caseload from start to finish.
- Working knowledge of CCMS and Legal Aid Agency procedures.
- Experience in legal aid-funded family law work.
- A law degree or equivalent legal qualification.
- Strong drafting, organisational and communication skills.
- Good attention to detail and proficiency in Microsoft Office and case management systems.

Desirable:
- Candidates who can speak additional languages

The candidates from the following background will be considered:
- Family Paralegal, Family Law Paralegal, Domestic Abuse Paralegal, Family Legal Assistant, Paralegal, Family Legal Secretary, Family Law Assistant, Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary.

What's on offer:
- Company pension
